notes.notes: This small update contains a fix for the control mapper losing focus when attempting to map custom controls.

notes.title: Formula Retro Racing v1.0.50 update
notes.notes:
This version of Formula Retro Racing includes the following updates.
- New GP Game mode featuring up to 4 player split screen local multiplayer
- Improved controller support with controller remapping functionality
- Racing wheel support (recommended that wheels are calibrated to 270 degrees rotation)
- Numerous bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Formula Retro Racing 1.0.40 beta update
notes.notes:
We have just released our latest update (v1.0.40 beta) in the Beta branch. This update includes the following.

- New Grand Prix game mode which features the following
  - Single player or up to 4 player split-screen multiplayer
  - Racing from a standing start
  - Selectable number of laps

- Cars now take damage rather than exploding on first collision

- Improved racing wheel support and custom mapping through the control mapper in settings.

- Improved frame rates on lower-end hardware

- Fixed problem with reduced steering sensitivity following a crash

- Removed slow transition on switching to rear-view camera

- Various bugfixes and improvements

We would love it if you could try this beta update and let us know if you experience any issues.

Thanks....

notes.title: Formula Retro Racing Update available (v1.0.15)
notes.notes:
Based on player feedback we have just released an update that includes the following

- Fixed an issue where double background music would play if the restarting from pause menu after quitting

- Fixed problem with countdown timer increasing in speed if passing the start / finish line during a crash

- Fixed problem with camera and gear buttons on machines with high refresh displays

- Fixed grey lap numbers at left of screen on eliminator sometimes showing the values from the previous race

- Camera view selection is now retained across races

- Cockpit camera is now perfectly centered in the car

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

notes.title: Formula Retro Racing Update available (v1.0.14)
notes.notes:
Hi,

We've listened to your feedback and just released an update which includes the following

- Time Extended text moved towards bottom of the screen so that it no longer obstructs view while racing.

- Countdown timer in Arcade mode is now paused during a crash - This means that a crash is no longer immediately game over on Expert mode.

- Fixed a problem where sometimes after crashing the car would respawn pointing towards the barrier.

- Reduced level of punishment from hitting barriers. Most collisions with barriers will now reduce your speed slightly rather than stop you completely.

- Exit Game button added to main menu.

- Added resolution and full screen / windowed settings.

- Fix for blank names on leaderboards.

We hope these increase your enjoyment of the game and stay tuned for further updates
